title_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment in Tirana Entry!
description_en: The apartment has a total area of ​​94m2, of which 79.7 is the net area of ​​the apartment and 14.3m2 is the common area. The apartment is organized in a living room and two bedrooms, a balcony and two bathrooms. The apartment is located on the seventh floor and is sold together with a parking post at an extra price of €17,000.
